text:
nate_fin: FYI we received credit memo CM-443 from ResellCo EMEA for -€72,450. Vendor says it's a retroactive reseller rebate for Q4-2025 volume tiers. Unsure how to treat for month-end: reduce revenue, reduce COGS, or book as other income? tagging @ellie_rev @olivia_fp&a

ellie_rev: Need to understand original revenue presentation. Did we record reseller sales gross (revenue and commission) or net of reseller fees? Also need mapping to rev schedules and the customer/reseller IDs impacted.

kam_support: Uploaded CM and supporting calc: https://drive.redwood/finance/emea/CM-443-Rebate-Pkg.pdf. Line items show rebate allocated to onboarding credits and channel discount true-up.

olivia_fp&a: Materiality note 1 quarter threshold = €50k. This credit > threshold so month-end adjustment + disclosure. We need per-reseller GL mapping and whether any downstream customer refunds were issued previously.

billing-bot: CM-443 entered into AP/AR as vendor credit, VendorRef: RC-2026-Q4. Suggested staging: 2002-Accrued-Vendor -> apply against COGS on settlement.

ellie_rev: High-level accounting: if revenue was recorded gross and reseller commission treated as expense, rebate reducing our cost should hit COGS/commission expense (reduce expense). If we had net presentation (revenue already net of reseller), then rebate reduces revenue. We must evaluate contract language & invoices.

legal-bot: Reseller agreement s7.4 allows retrospective rebates up to 12 months for volume tiers; vendor calculation looks consistent with clause. No immediate legal objections to recognizing rebate.

nate_fin: I pulled the reseller invoice list and mapped amounts to our rev schedules. Quick breakout: RESELL-110 €28,000 (rev_sched 9021), RESELL-227 €18,750 (rev_sched 9033), RESELL-311 €12,500 (rev_sched 9021), others total €13,200 across small partners. Uploading CSV now.

ellie_rev: Thanks. For each reseller row we need: reseller_id, vendor_cm_ref, orig_rev_schedule_id, orig_invoice_no, rebate_amt, recommended_treatment (contra-revenue vs expense), and rationale. I'll run a sample for RESELL-110 to confirm.

olivia_fp&a: Draft JE options for review (preview only):
Option A (reduce COGS/expense if gross presentation):
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                    €72,450.00
Cr 6005 COGS - Channel Commissions        €72,450.00
Notes: allocate per-rev-schedule to reduce commission expense.

Option B (contra-revenue if net presentation):
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                    €72,450.00
Cr 4000 Revenue - Partner Net              €72,450.00
Notes: allocate to rev schedules per CSV mapping, update disclosures.

ellie_rev: Both look fine as templates. Decision per-row based on original presentation. Also: if any single reseller > €10k, FP&A lead sign-off required (per policy). RESELL-110 and RESELL-227 are >€10k.

billing-bot: Flagging invoices that may require credit memos to downstream customers: CUST-7002, CUST-7114 tied to RESELL-110.

kam_support: Ops note: we should prepare a short CS script in case partners ask about retroactive credits or reduced partner payouts. Will coordinate with partner ops.

nate_fin: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/finance/emea/CM-443-breakout.csv. I included a column "orig_presentation" with values gross/net where we have records, and "treatment_reco" for suggested accounting. Marked materiality_flag where rebate_amt>€10k.

ellie_rev: I'll review CSV and tag rows for contra-revenue vs expense. Also will notify external auditors since amount is above materiality for FY quarter close. Need to include a line in the close pack explaining vendor-initiated rebate and our selected treatment.

olivia_fp&a: Action list recap: 1) nate_fin -> confirm final per-reseller treatment + provide signed off CSV. 2) billing-bot/jeff_billing -> prepare JE posting templates for both options and hold for sign-off. 3) ellie_rev -> review and finalize disclosure for month-end pack and notify audit. 4) legal-bot -> confirm no contract disputes.

ellie_rev: One more: if we choose contra-revenue for any row, update revenue schedules (push adjustment IDs into tracker) and ensure revenue reconciliation ties to AR subledger.

nate_fin: Will have final CSV and decision matrix by 16:30 PT. Scheduling a quick 4pm sync if needed. Thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:
